description: A photograph depicting a rural, hilly landscape under an overcast sky. The foreground and midground show a mosaic of vibrant green fields, likely grasslands, interspersed with extensive areas of brown and reddish-brown scrub or heathland vegetation. Dry stone walls traverse the landscape, delineating the boundaries of several fields. Scattered within the hills are several small, white-walled houses with dark roofs. Sparse trees are also visible, particularly on the higher slopes. This image visually represents typical land cover categories such as "field layer" and "Heath and scrub formation" that are classified in land monitoring services like Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS).
